registro.subtitulo: Official channel for reporting criminal occurrences. Your statement will be reviewed by police authorities for triage, validation, and tactical dispatch.

instrucoes.publico_alvo: Service available to any citizen with a valid Brazilian Tax ID (CPF) or foreign citizen with official identification, aged 18 or older.
instrucoes.etapa_1: 1. Complete identification of the reporting citizen with valid ID, email address, and contact phone number.
instrucoes.etapa_2: 2. Detailed description of the incident circumstances and geographic coordinates on the map.
instrucoes.etapa_3: 3. Police triage by the Chief Investigator, who will review and approve (validate) or reject the official police report.
instrucoes.etapa_4: 4. Email notification and real-time tracking on this portal using the generated protocol number.
instrucoes.aviso_legal: Warning: Filing a false police report is a criminal offense under Art. 340 of the Brazilian Penal Code, punishable by detention or fine.
instrucoes.urgencia_aviso: In case of immediate danger, threat to life, or crimes in progress, do not file an online report — call 190 immediately.

registro.email_ajuda: Required for receiving police validation confirmation and updates.
registro.telefone_ajuda: Used for operational contact and notifications.
registro.relato_placeholder: Describe clearly what happened, traits of suspects, or involved property...
registro.endereco_placeholder: E.g.: 123 Main Street, Downtown, near city square
registro.mapa_label: Map Positioning (click to adjust exact coordinates)
registro.declaracao_texto: I hereby declare that I am 18 years of age or older and that all information provided herein is true, under the penalties of Art. 340 of the Brazilian Penal Code (False Report of Crime).
registro.sucesso_mensagem: Your report was submitted to SGOPI Sentinela and is now in the official triage queue for police screening.
registro.guardar_aviso: Keep this number to track the validation and status of your police report.

publica.subtitulo: Track the progress of an incident or verify the authenticity of an issued Police Report. No login required.

protocolo.ajuda: Enter the protocol received when the incident was filed (format SGOPI-YYYY-NNNNNN) to see its current stage.
protocolo.detectado: Protocol format recognized — tracking mode selected automatically.
protocolo.nao_encontrado: No incident report found with the given protocol. Please verify the code and try again.

chave.ajuda: Enter the 24-character key printed on the Police Report, or scan the document's QR Code with your phone camera.
chave.detectado: Security key format recognized — verification mode selected automatically.
chave.vazio: Enter the key printed on the document
chave.nao_encontrado: Document not found. Check the printed key and, if the problem persists, contact the issuing police station.

lgpd: In compliance with data protection law, the public portal shows only the document's verification data — never names, IDs, addresses or the narrative of the facts.

resultado.explicacao_VALIDO: The key matches a document issued by the system and its content has not changed since the Chief's validation.
resultado.explicacao_ADULTERADO: The key exists, but the current content does not match the hash recorded at validation. The occurrence has been flagged for fraud investigation.
